regression_remediation.description: Batch 5A (WS-A.3 score badge) introduced 6 violations of `has no arbitrary utility text size below 12px` in components/directory/canonical-tool-card.tsx (text-[9px], text-[10px], text-[11px] for the editorial score badge). Fixed by replacing with `text-xs` (12px) and `text-[0.8125rem]` (13px on sm:). No visual regression — score badge still reads clearly at 12px minimum.

Not blocking production.

reconciliation_with_user_reported_baseli.user_reported_24_failures: 23 failed tests / 588 passed (one regression introduced by Batch 5A, now fixed)
reconciliation_with_user_reported_baseli.explanation: The user-reported baseline of 4 was an undercount — the actual baseline (parent commit a19e2bc) had 23 failures. Of these: 4 were explicitly known (3 B40 + 1 runtime), 17 were QueryClient context issues in vibe-home-v2, and 2 were typography contract issues (Fraunces import + CSS font-size). The 24th failure introduced by Batch 5A (6 sub-12px arbitrary utility violations in canonical-tool-card.tsx) has been fixed. The current state is back to the pre-Batch-5 baseline: 23 failed / 588 passed.
